name: Dom naroda Parlamenta Federacije BiH
notes: House of Peoples of the FBiH Parliament (80 delegates). No seat chart: no current official delegate list could be read (the parlamentfbih.gov.ba delegate page still shows the 2014-2018 term) and the register's one delegate, Aner Žuljević, is not verified as sitting.

name: Predstavnički dom Parlamentarne skupštine BiH (House of Representatives)
notes: 42 seats. Members and parties from the Parliamentary Assembly's own list of representatives for the 2022-2026 term (parlament.ba/representative/list, 5 pages), read 2026-11-04. Two entries show no party on the list (Mehmedović, Stojanović); Karamehić-Abazović (no party shown) is counted with the Naša stranka club she sits in. General elections were held in October 2026; this is the outgoing house until the new one is constituted. No supporter in the register sits here.

name: Dom naroda Parlamentarne skupštine BiH (House of Peoples)
notes: 15 seats (5 per constituent people). Delegates and parties from the Parliamentary Assembly's own list for 2022-2026 (parlament.ba/delegate/list), read 2026-11-04; Novaković-Bursać (SNSD, until 2024-10-10) is left out and Vuković (PDP, from 2024-10-10) counted. Outgoing house until the October 2026 elections' result is constituted. No supporter in the register sits here.

name: Predstavnički dom Parlamenta Federacije BiH (FBiH House of Representatives)
notes: 98 seats. Seats per party counted on the House's own member list 'Zastupnici' (predstavnickidom-pfbih.gov.ba/zastupnici), read 2026-11-04, 2022-2026 term (club chairs: https://predstavnickidom-pfbih.gov.ba/klubovi-stranaka). Damir Nikšić is listed under the independents. Outgoing house until the result of the October 2026 elections is constituted.
